results.title: Reasoning as a Service: How Composite AI Architectures Create Defensible Value
results.content: # Reasoning as a Service: How Composite AI Architectures Create Defensible Value | by Adnan Masood, PhD. # Reasoning as a Service: How Composite AI Architectures Create Defensible Value. ## The Architect’s Guide to AI Reasoning — An In-depth Analysis of Symbolic, Probabilistic, Connectionist, and Neurosymbolic Hybrid Methodologies in a Chain-of-thought reasoning paradigm. > I provides a taxonomy of ten different AI reasoning paradigms (from symbolic logic to reinforcement learning) and makes the case that the future of robust, trustworthy AI lies in a “pragmatic synthesis” — hybrid architectures that combine the strengths of these different methods to build more reliable and transparent systems. Many leaders I speak with believe that with the advent of large language models, the problem of “reasoning” in AI is largely solved.
